item.title: Baidu Launches AI-Powered BaiduWiki for Global Audiences
item.description: Chinese technology giant Baidu recently launched BaiduWiki, an artificial intelligence-driven online encyclopaedia, to target international users and bridge information gaps. item.title: Beijing Innovation Park Drives Robotics Sector Growth

The National Information Technology Application Innovation Park hosts over 1,000 technology companies focusing on areas like artificial intelligence (AI), quantum information, and 6G communications. item.title: Agibot Humanoid Robots Showcase Kung Fu Skills at Shaolin Temple
item.description: Chinese robotics firm Agibot released a new video showcasing its humanoid robots practicing martial arts at China’s historic Shaolin Temple. The robots demonstrated impressive synchronicity and precision at China’s historic Shaolin Temple.

item.title: AI Film School Equips Future Hollywood Filmmakers
item.description: Curious Refuge, which launched in May 2023, has quickly established itself as a prominent training ground for Hollywood professionals eager to adapt as generative technology transforms production processes. This shift has sparked new career opportunities, even as some industry insiders express concerns about job security in the face of AI advancements.

item.title: Modular Robots Boost Resilience by Sharing Resources
item.description: Roboticists at EPFL have demonstrated that modular robots can become significantly more resistant to failure by sharing power, sensing, and communication resources among individual units. This approach reverses the trend where traditional robotic systems often lose functionality if one element breaks down.
